text:
maria: noticed a jump in 5xx for embeds in eu1 starting ~03:40 UTC, impacting medium-length requests. Looks like thread pool starvation.

devon: any recent deploys?

maria: no deploys in window. Likely the connection timeout tweak regressed under higher concurrency. Need a warmfix and expedited approval for eu1 only.

simon: product signs off for a regional hotfix. We need minimal blast radius: canary 5% -> 30% -> 100% with 2m observation windows.

ops-oncall: ops-oncall: standing by. I'll open a short-lived alert policy for embeds. Pager: jordan.

maria: summary & risk: small binary bump, drops pool wait from 2s->1s. Risk: slightly higher immediate failures for very long tail requests but should reduce queueing. Rollback if 5xx >0.6% OR request_qtime p95 > 600ms for 2 consecutive mins. Release shortlink: https://go.redwood/release/embeds-warmfix-20260322

devon: approvals? @simon + @ops-oncall?

simon: +1

ops-oncall: approved, ops watching. Ready for /deploybot.

devon: executing: /deploybot start --svc=embeds --region=eu1 --img=gcr.io/redwood/embeds:warmfix-20260322 --canary=5% --step-wait=2m

releasebot: releasebot: job queued: deploy-6159990000-1. Starting canary (5%).

deploybot: deploybot: canary pods up (2/2). Healthchecks ok. No 5xx in first 45s.

jordan: watching error-rate and p95. tagging dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/embeds/eu1

deploybot: canary stable after 2m. Advancing to 30%.

maria: good. hold rollback CLI nearby: /deploybot rollback --job deploy-6159990000-1 --to=gcr.io/redwood/embeds:stable-20260320

devon: noted. Also have kubectl fallback: kubectl set image deploy/embeds embeds=gcr.io/redwood/embeds:stable-20260320 -n eu1

jordan: slight blip at 30% -> small spike to 0.4% 5xx for 90s, p95 stable. Ops says continue and watch.

simon: ok continue to 100% if no sustained breach.
deploybot: rollout reached 100% at 03:49 UTC. Final check: 5xx back to baseline, p95 improved ~120ms.

ops-oncall: ops-oncall: confirmed metrics stable. Closing expedited window. Will create short follow-up runbook and add to changelog.

maria: thanks team ":thumbsup:" Will post a mini postmortem tomorrow with root cause and remediation.
